summary: Electrical and Computer Engineering researcher, educator, and machine-learning engineer with a PhD from the University of Oklahoma focused on AI/ML for wireless networks. Research emphasizes reliable learning, 5G/6G network intelligence, propagation and digital-twin modeling, self-healing, transfer learning, generative augmentation, and reinforcement learning. Experience includes university teaching, research mentoring, laboratory instruction, curriculum development, and interdisciplinary publication work, supported by industrial R&D at AT&T Labs, Futurewei, Impac, and AT&T.

skills.Simulation & Experimentation: 3GPP-compliant simulation, synthetic data, experimental testbeds, statistical analysis, robustness testing, cross-validation, distribution-shift evaluation, and reproducible research workflows
